subject.title: fix(agents): stop runs at the critical tool-loop threshold

question: Should `plugins.entries.codex.config.appServer.loopDetectionPreToolUseRelay: false` remain a PreToolUse-only opt-out, or become the documented opt-out for the paired PreToolUse/PostToolUse loop-detection relay path?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent either way, but the existing configuration key is public and its historical documentation stated a narrower behavior; choosing the durable compatibility contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Confirm paired opt-out
options.body: Keep the branch behavior: false disables both loop-detection-only relays while leaving policy, trusted-tool, and middleware relays active.

options.title: Preserve narrow opt-out
options.body: Adjust the Codex relay wiring and focused configuration coverage so false disables only PreToolUse as previously documented.

recommendation.title: Confirm paired opt-out
recommendation.body: Keep the branch behavior: false disables both loop-detection-only relays while leaving policy, trusted-tool, and middleware relays active.

likelyOwner.reason: They have already isolated and documented the decision boundary and can apply the chosen contract, though final product direction remains a maintainer call.
